decisions.reason: Low-cost add-on to core address data, keeping the option open while demand remains uncertain.
Austrian expansion is close to core but less proven, yet the database costs little to maintain.
Critical compliance calculation for network operators, likely valuable and cheap to keep available.
Tariff database supports core customer needs with several models, so option value persists at low cost.
Custom web services are less scalable but preserve client relationships and flexibility at minimal fixed expense.
Simple lookup complements the platform and costs little to keep as an option.
